newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-POLAND'S CITKO GOES ON SALE FOR RECORD SUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POLAND'S CITKO GOES ON SALE FOR RECORD SUM.

text.p: Poland striker Marek Citko has been placed on the transfer market for about $6 million, the largest sum ever for a Polish player, his club Widzew Lodz said on Tuesday.
English premier league club Leeds and Italy's Inter Milan have expressed an interest in signing the player.

"Citko can go to either one of the clubs...we sent our offers to Inter Milan and Leeds United and are awaiting answers, which are likely to come by the end of the month," Widzew president Andrzej Pawelec said.
Citko won the attention of talent scouts after scoring the opening goal in Poland's World Cup qualifier against England at Wembley on October 9. England eventually won the game 2-1.
Citko also scored two goals for Widzew in this year's Champions' League, but the Polish champions failed to qualify for next spring's quarter-final round.
